create_grpc_interceptor: create an ExceptionInterceptor instance with a shutdown callback for gRPC error handling
intercept_grpc_method: intercept a gRPC server method call and handle exceptions with automatic CUDA cache clearing
handle_runtime_error: handle RuntimeError exceptions in gRPC methods by triggering a shutdown callback
clear_cuda_cache: clear the CUDA cache when an exception occurs during gRPC method execution
abort_with_status: abort a gRPC context with an INTERNAL status code and error message
